meaning: Asset count and text-length minimums of a non-retail Performance Max asset group with brand guidelines off, as read from Google's Performance Max asset requirements page during the 2026-10-08 engineering review (finding R13-google-family:pmax-bulk-build-gap) and pinned here. Read again in full on 2026-11-17 (R2.5 M3, Q6, the lead's decision: the raw page, not a summary): every count matched except two maxima, which are re-pinned: LANDSCAPE_LOGO (the page says at most 20 per asset group; the transcription said 5) and YOUTUBE_VIDEO (at most 15; was 5). Two limits are not on that page. The 60-character short-description limit is on Google's Performance Max troubleshooting page (https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/performance-max/troubleshooting, read 2026-11-18): an AssetGroupError.SHORT_DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED means the asset group was missing a TEXT asset with 60 characters or less and a field_type of DESCRIPTION; the error is also in the pinned Google Ads v25 Discovery document ("At least one short description asset is required for a valid asset group."). The two `combined` caps (20 images, 5 logos) are not stated for the API: Google's Help page "Performance Max campaigns specs and format requirements" (https://support.google.com/google-ads/answer/17091269, read 2026-11-18) says "Add up to 20 images" on each of its three image rows and "Add up to 5 logos" on both its logo rows, which reads as those shared caps, so they stay, and remain UNVERIFIED for the API. Image ratios and sizes, policy and duplicate-text rules stay with Google.
